jupyterlite/xeus-lite-demo.rationale: Repository is a template for creating JupyterLite deployments with xeus kernels, with a deploy workflow publishing to GitHub Pages and a demo notebook.

voila-dashboards/.github.rationale: The repo contains only community health files like CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, SECURITY.md, and issue templates, with README explicitly stating it holds 'Community health files for the @voila-dashboards organization'.

voila-dashboards/hotpot_km.rationale: The repository contains a Python package with source code under hotpot_km/ and is published to PyPI as 'hotpot-km', indicating it is a library for managing Jupyter kernels.

voila-dashboards/tljh-voila-gallery.rationale: Readme and setup.py show this is a plugin for The Littlest JupyterHub that installs a Voilà Gallery, so its primary purpose is a package.

voila-dashboards/voici.rationale: The repo contains Python packages voici and voici-core, which turn notebooks into static web apps.

voila-dashboards/voici-demo.rationale: The repository is a template for deploying Voici dashboards as static sites, as indicated by its README and deploy workflow publishing to GitHub Pages.

voila-dashboards/voici-gallery.rationale: The repository is a gallery website of Voici examples, as evidenced by README stating 'This is a gallery of Voici examples' and it appears to be a static site deployed via GitHub Actions.

voila-dashboards/voila.rationale: The repo has Python package structure ('voila/' package directory), published packages on PyPI and NPM, and CI publishing steps.
voila-dashboards/voila.security_boundary: renders untrusted Jupyter notebooks and executes kernel callbacks per user

voila-dashboards/voila-dashboards.github.rationale: The repository contains only GitHub Pages files (index.html, _layouts, _posts) serving the Voilà organization site, with no code, CI workflows, or published packages.

voila-dashboards/voila-debug.rationale: This repo is a Voilà template installed via pip, containing template files and static assets for Voilà applications.

voila-dashboards/voila-gridstack.rationale: It is a Voilà template distributed via PyPI and npm (voila_gridstack Python package, @voila-dashboards/jupyterlab-gridstack), and contains JupyterLab extension source in src/.

voila-dashboards/voila-heroku.rationale: Repository is a template/example for deploying a Voilà notebook application to Heroku, evidenced by README instructions, Procfile, and notebook.

voila-dashboards/voila-huggingface.rationale: The repo is a template/demo for deploying Voila dashboards to Hugging Face Spaces, containing notebooks and deployment configuration.

voila-dashboards/voila-material.rationale: The repository provides a pip/conda installable Voilà template, with template files under share/jupyter/voila/templates/material and a published PyPI package.

voila-dashboards/voila-railway.rationale: The repository contains a Procfile and requirements for deploying Voila to Railway, with a 'Deploy on Railway' button and a live demo link.

voila-dashboards/voila-template-cookiecu.rationale: The repository provides a Cookiecutter template for generating new Voilà templates, as evidenced by the cookiecutter.json and project scaffolding files.

voila-dashboards/voila-topbar.rationale: The repository defines a Voila extension package (published as PYPI:voila-topbar and NPM:voila_topbar) that adds a configurable top bar to dashboards.

voila-dashboards/voila-vuetify.rationale: The repository provides a Voilà dashboard template based on VuetifyJS, distributed as the PyPI package 'voila-vuetify', and contains template files under share/jupyter/voila/templates/.

voila-gallery/cpp-xleaflet.rationale: The repository contains a single Jupyter notebook (index.ipynb), a Binder launch link for rendering it with Voilà, and no CI workflows or packages, indicating a demo example.

voila-gallery/electricitymap_dashboard.rationale: The repository contains a single Jupyter notebook (Main.ipynb) alongside data files and configuration, with a minimal README, indicating an example dashboard project.

voila-gallery/gaussian-density.rationale: The repository contains a single notebook and a Binder link, showing a gallery example of Voilà visualization.

voila-gallery/hello-world-example.rationale: Contains a sample `app.ipynb` Voilà dashboard with setup instructions for Binder, serving as a getting-started example.

voila-gallery/ipympl.rationale: Contains a single notebook ipympl.ipynb and a GIF demonstrating an interactive matplotlib demo, with no package publishing or CI workflows.

voila-gallery/render-stl.rationale: The repository is a Binder example that demonstrates rendering STL files with Voilà and ipyvolume, as shown by the Binder badge and README title.

voila-gallery/voila-gallery.github.io.rationale: The repository is the website for voila-gallery.org, as noted in the README 'View the gallery at https://voila-gallery.github.io' and contains HTML/CSS/JS files under index.html, css/style.css, and js/index.js.

voila-gallery/voila-spotify.rationale: The repository contains a Binder-ready Voila application (environment.yml, jupyter_config.json, Spotify_viewer.ipynb) for visualizing Spotify data, with no CI workflows or published packages, indicating a demo example.
